item.title: Carol A. Dunlap
item.description: Carol A. Dunlap, 80, of Grove City, passed away at 1:27 a.m. on Thursday, December 18, 2025, at Grove Manor. Born in Grove City on March 10, 1945, she was the daughter of the late Richard and Ruth Campbell Deniker. She was a 1963 graduate of Allegheny Clarion Valley High School.
